claude.result:
Weekly plans now work. `subtrack add "Meal kit" 59.90 --every week` is accepted, and the full test suite passes (35 tests). I also ran the CLI by hand: that plan shows €259.57 a month, and with `--since 2026-10-20` it renews on 27 Oct.

- **Monthly cost:** a weekly plan costs its price × 52 ÷ 12, so €12 a week comes to €52.00 a month. `list`, `total`, `add` and `export` all show this figure. `export` had its own copy of the formula, so I made it use the shared function.
- **Rounding:** monthly costs are rounded to the nearest cent, so the €119.99 yearly plan shows €10.00.
- **Renewals:** weekly plans charge every 7 days from `--since`. If `--since` is still in the future, that date is the next charge.
- **`--every` values:** `--every week` and `--every weekly` both work, and the usage text, error message and README mention weeks.
- **Saved files:** the code that reads saved files treated any cycle it didn't recognise as monthly. A weekly plan would have turned into a monthly one the next time the file loaded, so I changed that.
- **Renewals order:** `renewals` was sorting by the label ("2 Nov" before "30 Oct") instead of the date. I changed it to sort by date.

I updated the old yearly tests that expected cut-off rounding, and added tests for the weekly cost and the 7-day schedule.

I haven't committed anything.
